paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates a representation of accuracy against the parameter alpha. The x-axis is labeled "α" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 4 inclusive, with tick labels at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and is linear, ranging from approximately 22.75% to 23.75%, with tick labels at 22.75%, 23.00%, 23.25%, 23.50%, and 23.75%. A single blue line with circular markers and a solid style is present in the plot, beginning at an accuracy of approximately 22.74% when α equals 0, increasing to a peak accuracy of approximately 23.74% when α equals 1, followed by a steady decline to an accuracy of approximately 22.74% when α equals 4.
